periods.time: Final battle in Luxel and postwar Vermillion recovery
periods.label: 在悲恸中驾驭超度觉醒的红莲皇女

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

periods.affiliation: Vermillion royal family; Hagun Academy; Vermillion representative team

status.current: alive, victorious, and preparing for future queenship after Lunaeyes renounces succession
status.condition: physically recovered; emotionally scarred by Ikki's death but steadied by his revival and her own resolve
status.goal: protect Vermillion, stay beside Ikki, and keep reaching out to Fia/Tatara

personality.summary: Fiery, righteous and deeply loving; grief nearly breaks her, but pride in her bond with Ikki lets her turn despair into controlled dragon power.
fears: letting Or-Gaule turn her despair into destruction

abilities_owned: Calusaritio Salamander amplified as giant light sword
radiant flame barriers and fire walls

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Fiance; his death devastates her, his final trust guides her, and his revival allows reconciliation after she condemns his broken promise.
relationships.or-gaule: Enemy who murders Ikki and tries to weaponize her despair; she ultimately burns him to ash and keeps a handful of remains for Alice's sake.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Relies on Shizuku to revive Ikki and trusts her enough to return to battle.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Teacher and support who promises to shield everyone from Stella's final blow.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Father who joins the battlefield and later tries to protect her propriety even after accepting Ikki more.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Mother who informs her of Tatara's attempted departure and supports her afterward.
relationships.yui-tatara: Former enemy and training mentor; Stella wants to keep her as Fia and tries to offer her a future in Vermillion.
relationships.john-kristoff-von-cobrand: Cousin; she gives him the chance to execute Or-Gaule and later encourages him to live with Lunaeyes's support.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Sister whose support of John and later succession renunciation shifts Stella toward future queenship.

periods.summary: Stella pursues Or-Gaule through Luxel's commercial district after Ikki takes Alice. She burns through Deus Ex Machina and severs his city-spanning threads with Calusaritio Salamander. Or-Gaule attempts to shake her trust in Ikki, but Stella declares that Ikki will keep his promise and she only needs to kill Or-Gaule. When he uses Quedland civilians as puppets, Stella's prior preparation brings Sirius, the Vermillion army, League troops, and Norman's Divine Gate into play; she dismembers Or-Gaule and throws him to John, seemingly ending the war. Or-Gaule's Danse Macabre corpse resurrects and strangles her, forcing Ikki to intervene. After Ikki is killed before her eyes and Or-Gaule crushes his head, Stella undergoes Ultra Awakening, grows horns, wings, scales, and a tail, but refuses to regret meeting Ikki. Her anger at Ikki's broken promise and pride in their love keep her mind intact. With Shizuku reviving Ikki and Nene shielding civilians, Stella fights Or-Gaule in her dragonized form. Ikki's delayed Kuruizakura cuts disrupt Or-Gaule's La Grand Guignol, allowing Stella to pierce him with Laevateinn and burn him to ash. She rebukes him for ignoring Alice's love, keeps some ash to bury with Alice, and declares victory. In hospital she reconciles with Ikki after first avoiding him in anger. Later she stops Tatara from leaving, offers her a role as future queen's guard, accepts Tatara's refusal, but receives her true name Fia and contact information, deciding not to give up on reaching her.

key_events.summary: Uses preparation and allied troops to defeat Or-Gaule's hostage tactic and lets John take revenge.
Is strangled by Danse Macabre and witnesses Ikki die buying her recovery time.
Controls Ultra Awakening and destroys Or-Gaule with dragon flame.
Fails to keep Tatara in Vermillion but receives her true name and a future connection.
